text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Hanshin Daishoten.
One of the few graded stakes races over 3,000 meters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a race requiring steady, calm pacing
with every lap, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, ya see...
I've been feelin' kinda restless. For a few days now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It ain't really a big deal. But the other day,
durin' that Classic-class race...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap claims her first GIII victory!
Displaying such terrifying strength on turf... Just what are we witnessing?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even in a graded race, she ran just as brilliantly as the rumors said!
We still haven't seen her limits. Just how strong is she!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm always watchin' her since we're roommates.
I used to think she was just a spaced-out, do-things-at-her-own-pace kind of gal, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Lately, there are times when she looks like an Umamusume I don't even know. Like someone with fathomless depth.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...It's weirdly bugging me. Whenever I watch her run,
it feels like something's tingling deep in my chest..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap. Being one generation younger in the Classic Class,
she has never once faced her in a race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, why does it weigh on my mind so much?
I don't know the reason, but still...
choice_data_list: Let's focus on the race right in front of us for now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
choice_data_list: We're aiming for the "Tenno Sho (Spring)" from here, right?
We're aiming for the "Tenno Sho (Spring)" from here, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. ...What in the world am I sayin'?
Something's wrong with me..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri is Oguri, and I'm me!
It'll ruin everything if I wipe out before the main event.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, 3000m! The old me might've
gotten all worked up and rushed it, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I haven't forgotten the patience you taught me over those two years. Hold back, save up stamina—and strike at the very end!
